lessons.title: Build REST API Endpoint Response Objects
lessons.description: Format backend REST API response dictionaries: make_api_response(data, status) returns a dict with the status code under status_code and the payload under body. The test checks that make_api_response({'msg': 'ok'})['status_code'] equals 200.
lessons.solution_code:
def make_api_response(data: dict, status: int = 200) -> dict:
    return {"status_code": status, "body": data}
